description: SHEIN affiliate via Awin (and historically other networks). Prefer Awin product feed and deeplink APIs; reuse lib/commerce/awin.mjs after an approved advertiser join. Checked 2026-10-14.

capabilities.title: Read SHEIN product feed rows with currency through Awin

capabilities.title: Generate tracking deeplinks for SHEIN product URLs via Awin
